title: Minimal grounded+neutral kill-gate eval (handful of fixtures, early go/no-go)
context: Before investing in M2 content (pilot jurisdiction budget explainers), the project needs an early signal that the grounded+cited+neutral approach actually produces better output than a blank-slate 'summarize this budget' baseline. This minimal kill-gate eval at M1 answers that question on a small fixture set so content investment is gated on a go/no-go rather than waiting for the full M4 eval (eval-015). If grounded+cited+neutral does not at least trend ahead of baseline on accuracy, citation, and neutrality, M2 content work pauses for review. Depends on ingest-006 and reconcile-007.
objective: Implement a minimal eval harness that runs grounded+cited+neutral generation against a blank-slate baseline on a small fixture set and reports the delta on accuracy, citation coverage, and neutrality as an early go/no-go signal before M2 content investment.
acceptanceCriteria: Runs grounded+cited+neutral generation versus a blank-slate 'summarize this budget' baseline on a small fixture set
Reports the delta on accuracy, citation coverage, and neutrality for both approaches
If grounded+cited+neutral does not at least trend ahead of the blank-slate baseline on all three dimensions, M2 content investment pauses for review rather than proceeding
The go/no-go result is recorded and referenced in the M1 Definition of Done
Reviewed and signed off by the maintainer and neutrality reviewer; PR merged with green CI
output: A merged PR containing the minimal eval harness (scripts/eval-explainer.ts or similar) that compares grounded+cited+neutral versus blank-slate generation on fixtures and records an early go/no-go result gating M2 content investment.
